cases.refreshed: Come join the fun every Wednesday for Baby Storytime & Stay and Play at the Los Altos Library! We invite all non-walking babies (ages 0-1) and their amazing caregivers to jump into an interactive 20 minutes of catchy songs & silly rhymes; gentle movement & baby sign language; and short books perfect for little eyes. Stick around afterward for our popular "Stay & Play" session, where babies can explore fun, age-appropriate toys, and you can chat with other local parents and caregivers! It's the perfect weekly activity to boost early literacy, build community, and make some wonderful memories. Please feel free to bring a small blanket for your baby's comfort! When: Wednesdays, 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM; Where: Los Altos Library, Orchard Room. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
